errors.trigger: User did not supply a fixed point and did not answer the follow-up
errors.diagnosis: The diff range cannot be pinned without a commit, branch, tag, or revision
errors.rescue_action: Ask for a commit, branch, tag, or revision to diff against HEAD
errors.user_message: No fixed point to review against. Supply a commit, branch, tag, or revision.

errors.trigger: Fixed point does not resolve, or the repository is not a git work tree
errors.diagnosis: Review requires git history and a resolvable ref for the diff range
errors.rescue_action: Verify git status and the ref; re-run with a valid fixed point
errors.user_message: Cannot resolve the fixed point or find git history. Check the ref and retry.

errors.trigger: Diff is empty between fixed point and HEAD
errors.diagnosis: An empty diff contains nothing to review on either axis
errors.rescue_action: Choose an earlier fixed point or confirm the correct branch is checked out
errors.user_message: Nothing changed between the fixed point and HEAD. Nothing to review.

errors.trigger: A sub-agent or issue-fetch command failed
errors.diagnosis: Review depends on sub-agent execution and optionally remote issue fetch
errors.rescue_action: Re-run the failed axis alone; paste spec text if issue fetch is unavailable
errors.user_message: A review step failed. Re-run the failed axis, or paste the spec text directly.
